screens.title: Inbox (Interactive)
screens.prompt:
Add interactive prototype links to the Inbox screen while strictly preserving the existing UI, text, and layout:
- Link the settings gear icon in the header to the Settings screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_15}}).
- Link the task cards (e.g., "ул. Макаёнка, 9, кв. 114") to the Task Details screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_10}}).
- In the bottom navigation bar, link the 'Closed' button/icon to the Closed Tasks screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_16}}).
- The 'Inbox' button in the bottom navigation should remain on the current screen.
- Ensure all other elements, including the purple header, the address chips, and the action buttons like "Отчёт", are visually identical to {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_18}}.

outputComponents.text:
I've updated the **Inbox** screen with interactive prototype links to complete your technician workflow navigation:

- **Settings Gear**: Tapping the gear icon in the top right now navigates to the **Settings** screen.
- **Task Cards**: Tapping a task card (like the one for "ул. Макаёнка, 9, кв. 114") now opens the **Task Details** view.
- **Bottom Navigation**: 
    - The **Closed** island button now correctly links to the **Closed Tasks** screen.
    - The **Inbox** island button is set to remain on the current screen.

The Beltelecom visual design, task list layout, and Russian localization have been strictly preserved. You can now test the full navigation flow directly in the prototype preview.
